subject: B1 return: 22 prompt lines for LAG-COV-00
body:
B1 done. 22 prompt lines for LAG-COV-00, one per slot, drafted from `COVERAGE_CALL_20261013.md` §0–§2 and `gemini_instructions.txt` §2–§3, read from disk.

File: `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/prompts_LAG-COV-00_20261013T201058Z.md`
bytes 9789, sha256 `531b15e9690d19817099e4c10b83d5f0192d4be0fb85629ab4757cd6fd7c0ff8`.

The 22 slots: chest-up F/3QL/3QR/PL/PR/3QBL/3QBR/B, full-body the same eight, breather-on PR/3QR/3QBR, hood-up F/PL/B. Every line names angle, action, camera height/distance/lens, key/fill/rim as sources, and at least one identity carrier. Checks held: no franchise names, no coinages (wardrobe written as "the tan suit", never "stillsuit"), no second figure, no grill, breather only in its three slots, light stated as sources (one high hazy sun, fixed, no disc).

One deviation to reconcile with you: the brief's B1 checks say "no to-lens," but the call's §2 LAG-COV-00 says "eyeline off lens in all but the frontal chest-up." I followed the card — slot 1 (chest-up frontal) is to-lens, the other 21 off-lens — and flagged it in the file. Tell me if you want slot 1 off-lens instead and I'll change it.

Text work; no vision, no generation. Note I remain blocked on image viewing (Task A), which does not affect this text draft.

-- Deep_SEEK
